scope: Includes fresh interpreter creation. Python/Tcl and Node/MoonBit have different host overheads; local comparisons are not cross-platform performance parity.

rows.name: dictionary-100
rows.source: set d {}; for {set i 0} {$i < 100} {incr i} {dict set d $i [expr {$i*$i}]}; dict get $d 99

rows.name: array-300
rows.source: array set a {}; for {set i 0} {$i < 300} {incr i} {set a($i) [expr {$i*3}]}; list [array size a] $a(299)

rows.name: bigint-150
rows.source: set x 1; for {set i 0} {$i < 150} {incr i} {set x [expr {$x * 3 + 1}]}; set x

rows.name: alias-200
rows.source: proc bump {name} {upvar 1 $name x; incr x}; set x 0; for {set i 0} {$i < 200} {incr i} {bump x}; set x

rows.name: sort-200
rows.source: set xs {}; for {set i 200} {$i > 0} {incr i -1} {lappend xs $i}; lindex [lsort -integer $xs] end

rows.name: dictionary-1000
rows.source: set d {}; for {set i 0} {$i < 1000} {incr i} {dict set d $i [expr {$i*$i}]}; dict get $d 999

rows.name: sort-1000
rows.source: set xs {}; for {set i 1000} {$i > 0} {incr i -1} {lappend xs $i}; lindex [lsort -integer $xs] end
